safe.text: Safety hints, cut-off checks, injury red flags, heat and cold alerts are the same on both plans.
faq.trial.a: The free plan doesn't expire: prepare with it first, and subscribe when you find it useful.
faq.cancel.a: Yes. Under Plans and subscription, press Manage subscription to cancel; it runs to the end of the period, then you are back on the free plan.
faq.data.q: If I stop subscribing, is my data gone?
faq.data.a: Nothing is deleted. Your plan, activities and settings stay; charts beyond 365 days and backtests switch off, and full-resolution data older than a year is later kept as summaries (with a reminder first).
faq.pay.q: How do I pay? Do I get a receipt?
faq.pay.a: By card, on Polar's checkout page. Polar sells on our behalf and e-mails you the receipt; we never see your card number. It renews each period.
end.text: Make a plan on the free plan first; subscribe when you find it useful.
